Fixture files for `tests/test_bhavcopy.py`. The headers follow the published NSE layouts (legacy CM bhavcopy
`cmDDMONYYYYbhav.csv` and CM-UDiFF `BhavCopy_NSE_CM_0_0_0_YYYYMMDD_F_0000.csv`). **All prices, volumes and trade
counts are synthetic**: they are not real market data and must not be used as such.
